text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem comes from and understand why it happens. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and error messages, can help you locate issues quickly. However, tools alone are not enough. A systematic approach makes debugging easier: check the code step by step, test small parts, and change one thing at a time. Logging is also very useful because it records what the program does while it runs. With clear logs, you can see exactly where things go wrong and fix problems faster.
